0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Dabargar would have you avenge a fallen friend.

24.original: Speak with the Yok Huy guide.

25.original: Slay the beasts at the Shades of Grief.

26.original: Speak with the Yok Huy guide.

48.original: Ah, the hero who brought low Valigarmanda. I would beg your aid in exterminating a new threat that has visited the Yok Huy.

49.original: One of our kin recently went missing, only to turn up just outside the ruins at the Shades of Grief...reduced to a desiccated corpse.

50.original: Judging from the wounds, the poor soul must have been fed upon by a particularly formidable bloodsucker. This fiend cannot be suffered to live!

51.original: To lure it out, we have placed blood-soaked meat at strategic locations around the ruins. One of my comrades is there now, and he'd doubtless be grateful for your assistance.

52.original: You'll find the Shades of Grief down the road to the northwest. Would you meet with my comrade and check on the trap we've laid?

53.original: Gee hee hee... Ahem! Greetings, visitor!

54.original: You know the plan, yes? Well, there's a problem. Some <hex:021A020203>other<hex:021A020103> creatures have been drawn in by the smell of the meat, oh yes!

55.original: Yes, that despicable bloodsucker will never creep out from hiding so long as they're around! Yes, I'm afraid I must ask you to get rid of them!

56.original: Luckily, there is nothing our quarry loves better than fresh blood. The more of it, the better, oh yes!

57.original: I'll watch from a distance, yes? Once the creatures have been dealt with, come to the west side of the ruins. Hee hee...kee hee hee!

58.original: Gee hee hee! Finally. You must be so exhausted after all that dashing and slashing. As for me, I feel rather invigorated, oh yes!

59.original: Why, I was practically counting the seconds...until I could drain your life's blood!

61.original: The bloodsucker was disguised as my comrade all along!? Surely that cannot be!

62.original: F-Forgive me, I know not what to say. If the fiend was possessed of such an alarming ability, I should think someone would have made mention of it before now!

63.original: Years ago, the Head of Reason once speculated that the beasts we call bloodsuckers are in fact beings known as “voidsent,” come from another realm.

64.original: Others have even suggested they might be invaders from distant stars! I have heard many and more theories over the years, but perhaps I was unwise to shrug them off as I have.

65.original: In any case, the threat is no more, and our village owes you a debt. Now, if you will excuse me, I must find my missing comrade!
